correctness.rationale: Under the exact h-perfect halfspace model, c_v>=r yields clique barriers f(s)=1/(s+sqrt(s)) and odd cycle barriers g(l)=(l-1)/(2(l+sqrt(l)))=(1-1/sqrt(l))/2. f decreases and g increases; f(3)<g(5)<f(2)<g(7), so max-clique is binding except omega=2 with C5, where pentagon binds. Uniform r1 attains all barriers. Critical supports force coordinates c_v=r on union U and all others vary independently in small positive directions due finitely many strict inequalities, proving dimension n-|U|. The proof provides affinely independent stable-set vertices for max-clique facets and each C5 facet in the triangle-free case; tangent count is n plus #critical supports at uniform center. Handles edgeless omega1 and disconnected graphs.
